READ: The National Irrigation Administration (NIA) shared in a statement that the NIA Covered Court has been opened as a temporary shelter for families displaced by the fire that broke out in a residential area along NIA Road, Brgy. Pinyahan, Quezon City on Friday night, March 6.

Food and other basic assistance are currently being provided as coordination continues with the Quezon City LGU and other concerned agencies to support affected residents.

Courtesy: National Irrigation Administration/Facebook
